name: Writers Circle
place: Bolonia - Bario Italia (Av. Italia x Colo Colo)
description:
A free weekly meeting of people wanting a quiet, focussed, supportive space to work on their own writing projects.

It can be a book, blog, poem, letter to mom, shopping list, etc.

We chat a bit, share our writing goal for the day, then settle into our own project for a full hour.

Then reconvene to share how we did, and if anyone wants to read a bit of what they created, that is welcome but not required.
